prompts.walk: Use case: identity-preserve / animation asset generation. The attached /Users/caglarkc/Desktop/marsupilami.png is the REQUIRED master character reference. Preserve this exact Marsupilami design: yellow fur, black spots, adjacent white eyes with tiny black pupils, very large oval black nose with dark blue highlight, broad cream muzzle, mischievous smile, long floppy ears, 3 hair wisps, cream belly and palms, extremely long thin spotted tail. Keep original pixel-art look with sharp stepped contours and flat clustered shading, no 3D or smooth vector redesign. Produce an actual animation sprite sheet, not a concept poster: exactly EIGHT frames in a regular FOUR-column TWO-row grid, reading order left to right then next row. Canvas 1536x1024, eight equal 384x512 cells. No visible grid, no labels, no text, no ground shadows, no decorative symbols. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, not black, not white, not painted checkerboard. Every frame at identical scale and camera angle, character full body and full tail confined within its own cell with at least 20px margins. Feet baseline at local y=450 for standing frames, body center near local x=192. Don't recenter separate poses or zoom. Maintain anatomy, facial features, fur markings, and size consistently through the sequence. Tail coils compactly to fit cell but remains long and attached to lower back. Draw meaningful sequential animation changes, never eight unrelated illustrations. Animation: WALK RIGHT. Eight continuous in-place walk-cycle frames seen in right-facing three-quarter side view, face profile oriented RIGHT in EVERY frame. Frame 1 left foot forward contact, right foot back; 2 down weight on left front leg, rear heel rising; 3 passing right leg swings forward past planted left leg; 4 up right knee raised in front; 5 right foot forward contact, left foot back; 6 down weight on right front leg; 7 passing left leg swings forward; 8 up left knee forward leading back to frame 1. Clearly alternate front legs at frames 1 and 5; arms counter-swing opposite legs. Small head/body vertical bob, consistent large nose. Long tail trails to LEFT in a compact upright S curl and sways with delayed motion. NO ground translation within cells; walk in place. Resting friendly closed smile, awake eyes. This will be played as a loop at about 10fps; coherent footfall is essential.
